page: Microsoft Azure M96bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 server family. Powered by the x86_64 architecture, this instance features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at 4.0 GHz. It delivers 96 virtual CPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by a 105 MB L3 cache. The hardware configuration includes 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per virtual CPU.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate top-tier memory performance, with cached read-only small block memory bandwidth and uncached large block read/write memory bandwidth both ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), contribute to top-tier scores in Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Multi-core performance is strong, as evidenced by high throughput in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation tasks.

This server does not include local storage but is designed for high block storage performance and is premium storage capable. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated compute resources offer a balanced profile for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of local NVMe drives. The instance is highly suited for large-scale database operations, memory-cached applications, enterprise resource planning systems, and medium-scale language model inference tasks.

While it lacks local storage, it is premium storage capable and optimized for high block storage performance. Benchmarks show top-tier memory bandwidth and strong multi-core processing capabilities, aided by hardware-accelerated instruction sets like AVX-512 and AMX. This resource configuration makes the instance highly efficient for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including database operations, high-throughput web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference. It delivers exceptional database operation speeds and high-throughput static web serving, making it a robust choice for data-heavy applications requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated compute power.
